name: OYM Trilogy 2026 – Leg 3
short_description: OYM Trilogy 2026 Leg 3 closes the series on Sunday 13 December 2026 at Ayala Triangle, Makati, with a 26 km longest race plus 16 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Leg 3 of the OYM Trilogy 2026 is on Sunday 13 December 2026 at Ayala Triangle in Makati City, with the start listed at 4:00 am. The longest race is 26 km, with 16 km, 10 km and 5 km options, priced from PHP 1,550 to PHP 2,350 before fees. It is organised by OYM Events and follows Leg 2 in September 2026.

faqs.question: When is OYM Trilogy Leg 3?
faqs.answer: Leg 3 is on Sunday 13 December 2026, with the start listed at 4:00 am Philippine time on the MyRunTime entry page. Online registration closes on 8 December. Race kits can be picked up at Skin Station branches in Metro Manila malls, or collected on race day itself.

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: The final leg steps up to a 26 km longest race, beyond the 21 km offered at Leg 2. There are also 16 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Fees are PHP 2,350 for 26 km, PHP 1,950 for 16 km, PHP 1,750 for 10 km and PHP 1,550 for 5 km.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: Start and finish are at Ayala Triangle in the Makati central business district, the same base used for Leg 2. All entries include a singlet, bib, medal and timing chip, and 26 km finishers also receive a finisher shirt. The route map has not been published yet.
